caption:
Guinea-Bissau's military rulers delay elections by two years to 2028

Both presidential and parliamentary votes are pushed back, delaying the promised return to civilian rule. The new date for the votes is 2028.

Reported by Africanews; BBC.

headlines: Guinea-Bissau's military rulers delay elections by two years to 2028
dek: The postponement delays the country's promised return to civilian rule, a year after the military coup.
body: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders had promised a return to civilian rule within 12 months of the coup. The delay covers both presidential and parliamentary elections.
